dialog.english:
All right then, let's go to
Gennai's place!
Wait a second, what's this?!

Does he live in the middle of the
lake?

So that's why I couldn't find it,
even after searching the mountain
for two months.
dialog.translation:
Por eso no lo encontraba,
aunque busqué en la montaña
durante dos meses.

dialog.english: No waaaaay!

Does that mean we're supposed to
go down there?
dialog.translation:
¿Eso significa que tenemos que
bajar ahí abajo?

dialog.english: Okay, we'll try it!
Ah! Is that it?
I think so.
Pardon us! We're heading in!
Thank you for coming, children.
Is it the real one this time?
Yes.

Hey, old man! We've got something
to ask you!
What is it?

Why didn't you leave this place
and meet us in person earlier?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué no saliste de aquí
para vernos en persona antes?

dialog.english:
I'm a stay-at-home kind of guy and
I don't have much free time. Here,
this way.
dialog.translation:
Soy de los que no salen de casa
y no tengo mucho tiempo libre.
Por aquí.

dialog.english:
This is Myotismon's location on
Earth. He's around this spot.
dialog.translation:
Este es el sitio de Myotismon
en la Tierra. Está por aquí.

dialog.english: Ah!
Ah!
What's wrong?
It's nothing, no big deal. You?

It's nothing to worry about, it's
just...that's Karigaoka.
dialog.translation:
No es nada, es solo que...
eso es Hikarioka.

dialog.english: Karigaoka?!

I will now explain how to open the
gate.
dialog.translation:
Ahora os explico cómo abrir
la puerta.

dialog.english: Okay. We're counting on you.
Okay. We're counting on you.

Got it. So we just have to put
these cards on the slate in front
of the gate.
dialog.translation:
Entendido. Solo hay que poner
estas cartas en la piedra frente
a la puerta.

dialog.english:
If you make a mistake, you may end
up in another world, or fail to
come out in one piece.
dialog.translation:
Si os equivocáis, podéis acabar
en otro mundo, o no salir
de una pieza.

dialog.english:
So pay attention to the card
placement!
dialog.translation:
¡Fijaos bien en el orden
de las cartas!

dialog.english: Got it.

Be sure to get a good night's
sleep tonight.
dialog.translation:
Aseguraos de dormir bien
esta noche.

dialog.english: Are you ready?
Yes!

Chosen Children, you're dealing
with a difficult situation here. 
Believe in your own abilities.
dialog.translation:
Niños Elegidos, os enfrentáis
a una situación difícil.
Confiad en vuestra capacidad.

dialog.english: Yes!

Hey, Izzy, what did you do
while we were separated?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Izzy, ¿qué hiciste
mientras estábamos separados?

dialog.english: I was searching for Gennai.

A story that'll wrench the heart
out no matter what!
dialog.translation:
¡Seguro que es una historia
que te parte el corazón!

dialog.english:
But Tai was gone for two
months...
dialog.translation: Pero Tai estuvo fuera dos meses.

dialog.english:
You're right, it was around two
months.
Yup.

You were looking for Gennai for
two months?
(Talk about why I kept searching.)
(Talk about how I got frustrated.)

I'm thankful that Tentomon
accompanied me all this time.
dialog.translation:
Agradezco que Tentomon
me acompañara todo este tiempo.

dialog.english:
Yep! You and Tentomon are really
good friends!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Tentomon y tú sois
muy buenos amigos!

dialog.english: Just like you and Patamon, T.K.
Yeah! We're totally inseparable!

There were times when we wanted to
give up.
dialog.translation:
Hubo momentos en que quisimos
rendirnos.

dialog.english:
Really? That must have been quite
a journey.
dialog.translation:
¿En serio? Menudo viaje
debió de ser.

dialog.english:
At one point, I gave into my
weaknesses...
dialog.translation:
En un momento, cedí a mis
debilidades...

dialog.english:
So Gennai lives in this sort of
place.
dialog.translation: Gennai vive en un sitio así.

dialog.english:
I'm surprised as well. I didn't
think he would live somewhere like
this.
dialog.translation:
Yo también estoy sorprendido.
No pensé que viviría en un
sitio así.

dialog.english:
What on earth *is* that old guy
supposed to be, anyway?
dialog.translation:
¿Qué demonios es ese viejo,
en realidad?

dialog.english: A human?
A non-human existence?

A human who can't get back home,
like us?

But he's using a lot of amazing
technology that we don't have.
dialog.translation:
Pero usa tecnología increíble
que nosotros no tenemos.

dialog.english:
I don't think he's just an
ordinary human.
dialog.translation:
No creo que sea un humano
cualquiera.

dialog.english: You're probably right...

Maybe he's like the god of this
world?
dialog.translation: ¿Será como el dios de este mundo?

dialog.english: I think so, too.

Every time we hit a roadblock,
he pops in with suspiciously
convenient timing.
dialog.translation:
Cada vez que nos atascamos,
aparece justo a tiempo,
qué casualidad.

dialog.english: Sora, Tai was looking for you.
Really? What did he want?
It seemed like he needed help.
He was unusually excited...

I think it was something about a
button falling off and needing it
re-sewn on.
dialog.translation:
Creo que era algo de un botón
que se le cayó y necesitaba
que se lo cosieran.

dialog.english:
Did it rip off again? He's always
so reckless.
dialog.translation:
¿Se le cayó otra vez? Siempre
tan descuidado.

dialog.english: Thanks for telling me, Izzy!
Oh, it's no problem.

Seems like he's plotting something
sneaky.
Huh?!
As if he'd found a huge bug.
Ugh, Tai!

Thanks for letting me know,
Izzy!
Oh, it's no problem.

It seems you went through a lot of
hard work, Joe. Matt told me all
about it.
dialog.translation:
Parece que lo pasaste muy mal,
Joe. Matt me lo contó
todo.

dialog.english:
It really was. While everyone was
gone, I felt like I'd been working
in that restaurant forever.
dialog.translation:
Y tanto. Mientras todos estabais
fuera, sentí que llevaba toda
la vida en ese restaurante.

dialog.english:
But Joe, I feel like you've
changed a little.
dialog.translation:
Pero Joe, siento que has
cambiado un poco.

dialog.english: Really? In what way?
In appearance
In attitude

I feel like you've gotten a little
taller.
dialog.translation:
Siento que has crecido
un poco.

dialog.english:
Really? I don't think I've grown
that much.
dialog.translation:
¿En serio? No creo haber
crecido tanto.

dialog.english: I think you did, but...

So I didn't change that much after
all...
dialog.translation:
Así que no cambié tanto
al final...

dialog.english: Cheer up, Joe!

Your eyes are shining with
confidence.

Honestly, when I was alone, I
decided to stop relying on others.
dialog.translation:
La verdad, cuando estaba solo,
decidí no depender de nadie.

dialog.english:
I was able to re-examine myself
when I traveled alone, as well.
dialog.translation:
Pude replantearme a mí mismo
viajando solo, también.

dialog.english:
So it turned out for the better,
right?
It did!

We shouldn't keep Gennai waiting
too long.
dialog.translation:
No hagamos esperar
tanto a Gennai.

dialog.english: Let's hurry and meet Gennai.
dialog.translation: Vamos a ver a Gennai ya.

dialog.english: Talk with everyone for a bit longer.
dialog.translation: Hablar un poco más con todos.

dialog.english:
A lot of stuff happened to
everyone while we were separated,
huh.
dialog.translation:
Le pasaron muchas cosas a todos
mientras estábamos separados,
¿eh?

dialog.english:
A lot of stuff happened to us,
too!
Yup!

If it's all right with you,
T.K, I'd like to hear your
story as well.
dialog.translation:
Si te parece bien, T.K.,
me gustaría oír tu
historia también.

dialog.english:
Even after all this, Tai's
still Tai.
dialog.translation:
Después de todo esto, Tai
sigue siendo Tai.

dialog.english: You seem pleased about that, Sora.

If Gennai turns out to be human,
would he be Japanese?
dialog.translation:
Si Gennai resulta ser humano,
¿sería japonés?

dialog.english:
I don't know. There's a high
probability he's Japanese, but he
could also be a foreigner.
dialog.translation:
No lo sé. Es muy probable
que sea japonés, pero también
podría ser extranjero.

dialog.english:
I've met a surprising number of
those on the Internet.
dialog.translation:
He conocido a muchos así
por Internet, la verdad.

dialog.english:
Speaking of which, this garden
looks pretty suspicious.
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, este jardín
parece bastante sospechoso.

dialog.english:
Thinking about it again, every
time we went somewhere new...
dialog.translation:
Pensándolo bien, cada vez
que íbamos a un sitio nuevo...

dialog.english:
I was always saying stuff like
"There's got to be some humans
here!"
dialog.translation:
Yo siempre decía cosas como
"¡aquí tiene que haber
algún humano!"

dialog.english:
Now that I think about it, you're
right.

At least I've gotten pretty used
to this world.
dialog.translation:
Al menos ya me he hecho
bastante a este mundo.
